contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CON[--]S PF AVG ; R/ VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17, Trier mint. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CON[--]S PF AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding wreaths. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN. In exergue: PTR. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 14.5mm, Weight: 1.79gms, die axis: 6
